title: Case Study: Mountkirk Games — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Game Launch Day Flash Mob Surge: 10x traffic spike tests GKE Autopilot cluster node autoscaling and Spanner automatic splitting.
routing_rationale: Game launch spikes represent massive unpredictable demand; serverless elasticity cushions surges by provisioning thousands of nodes in parallel.

scenarios.label: Regional vCPU Quota Ceiling Blocks Scaling
scenarios.root_cause: Project hit hard default regional vCPU quota (limit: 5,000 vCPUs).
scenarios.diverted_path: GKE Autoscaler events show 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED'; players queued in matchmaking for hours.
scenarios.blast_radius: Launch day failure and lost player revenue.
scenarios.recovery: Submit proactive quota increase requests 3 weeks prior to major game launch events.
